title: Protocol to assess the effects of dysfunctional human vascular smooth muscle cells on other brain cells using in vitro models of Alzheimer's disease
protocol: Aspirate the medium from the culture plates.
Add 5 mL of PBS and gently swirl it to remove traces of serum from the culture medium.
Add 5 mL of Trypsin/EDTA solution.
Remove 4 mL of the solution immediately.
Monitor the trypsinization progress at room temperature under an inverted microscope.
If rounded cells are attached to the cell surface, release them by hitting the side of the plate against your palm until most of the cells are detached.
Add 5 mL of neutralizing Solution and transfer the solution into a 50 mL sterile conical tube.
Seed 300–400 × 10^5 cells (60% confluency) per well in a 6-well plate.
Place the cell culture plate in a standard incubator at 37°C and let cells acclimate for 24 h.
Replace with 2 ml of fresh growth medium containing PDGFBB, Tau P301 or LPS.
Change fresh growth medium containing neurotoxins every 24 h for 3 days.
Remove the culture media and wash the plate three times with 2 ml of PBS.
Aspirate the PBS from the plate without disturbing the cells.
Add 750 μl QIAzol Lysis Reagent per well and mix extensively by pipetting all over the plate.
Let sit for 10 min at room temperature before proceeding RNA extraction.
Use 100 ng of total RNA as the starting template for cDNA synthesis.
Synthetize cDNA via reverse transcription following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Use 100–150 ng of cDNA to perform RT-qPCR.
Dilute the cDNA samples with molecular grade water in a 1:5 ratio.
Thaw the gene-specific primers on ice.
Follow RT-qPCR protocol according to manufacturer’s instructions of the Applied BiosystemsTM SYBR GreenTM PCR Master mix.
Turn on the Real time PCR machine 30 min prior to running the qPCR.
Analyze gene expression by quantitative PCR (qPCR) on a SYBR green system.
Note: The fold change in gene expression can be calculated relative to the endogenous GAPDH control using the ddCT method.
Seed enough cells in an 8-well microscopy slides until obtain 50% confluency.
Allow cells to acclimate for 24 h before initiating treatment.
Replace with 2 mL of fresh growth medium containing PDGFBB, Tau P301 or LPS.
Change the fresh growth medium every 24 hours for 3 days.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL of PBS.
Fix cells with 4% formaldehyde for 20 minutes.
Permeabilize cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 15 minutes.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL of PBS.
Add 2 drops of phalloidin reagent per mL of media and incubate for 30 minutes.
Wash cells with 2 mL of PBS twice.
Use mounting medium containing DAPI (Diamond Antifade Mountant with DAPI).
Visualize cells using the Leica TCS SP8 confocal microscopy station on a 40× or 63× objective.
Acquire digitized pictures using the Leica Application Suite X software.
Analyze two-dimensional and white-light images using ImageJ software.
Adjust cellular concentration of VSMCs or microglia to 0.5 × 10^6 cells/mL using cell culture media.
Seed 250 μL of VSMCs or microglia into the silicone insert.
Stain VSMCs with CellTracker Green CMFDA and microglia cells with CellTracker Deep Red Dye overnight, following manufacturer’s instructions.
For nuclear staining use NucBlue live cell stain, 2 drops per mL for 16 h.
Add fresh 100 μL of medium containing neurotoxins to VSMCs.
Add fresh 100 μL growth normal medium containing neurotoxins to microglia cells.
Maintain the cells for 72 h in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove the silicone insert from the plate well using sterile forceps to begin the wound healing assay under normal growth medium.
Visualize wells under a fluorescence microscope after 0, 12, 24, and 48 hours, focusing on the center of the wound field.
Maintain the cells for 48 hours in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Image the cells using a 10× objective until they migrate to close the empty gap.
Seed 0.2 × 10^6 VSMCs at the bottom of a Transwell-12 plate and seed 0.2 × 10^6 microglia cells on top.
Incubate VSMCs with neurotoxins as indicated in the "generation of dysfunctional VSMCs" protocol.
After 72 hours, add 300 μL fresh normal growth medium to VSMCs.
Label microglia cells overnight (16 hours) with CellTracker Deep Red Dye.
Change the media to 300 μL fresh growth medium after labeling.
Position the insert containing microglia cells on top of VSMCs.
Maintain the cells for 16 hours in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Remove the top insert after 16 hours.
Wash the bottom compartment with 300 μL PBS.
Fix the cells with 300 μL of 4% formaldehyde for 10 minutes.
Wash the cells three times with 300 μL PBS.
Quantify the migration of microglia cells as the number of red cells migrated towards VSMCs.
Seed 0.2 × 10^6 VSMCs on a 12-well plate and incubate with neurotoxins.
In parallel, seed 0.2 × 10^6 microglia on a separate 12-well plate under normal growth conditions (final volume 500 μL).
Label VSMCs with CellTracker Deep Red Dye overnight followed by a change of fresh media.
Label microglia with NucBlue live cell stain overnight followed by a change of fresh media.
Trpsinize VSMCs, resuspend cells in normal growth media and count cells.
Seed 0.2–0.3 × 10^6 VSMCs on top of microglia under normal growth conditions for 48 hours.
Wash the co-cultured cells three times with PBS after 48 hours.
Fix cells with 4% formaldehyde for 10 minutes.
Perform immunostaining of MHC-II or desired cell marker of activated microglia.
Image the cells at 40× magnification using a fluorescent microscope.
Seed 0.2 × 10^6 VSMCs on a 12-well plate and incubate them with 2 mL of neurotoxins or fresh normal media for microglia (0.2 × 10^6) as indicated.
Add 2 mL of fresh media and incubate for 24 h.
Carefully aspirate supernatant into a sterile 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Spin down at 1000 × g for 2 min.
Use 500 uL of the supernatant to stimulate microglia for 24 h in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Wash three times with 1 mL of PBS.
Fix cells with 4% formaldehyde for 10 min.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% triton-x for 10 min.
Block cells with donkey serum at 10% for 1 h.
Incubate primary antibody (IL-6) overnight at 4°C.
Use desired secondary antibody and incubate 45 min at room temperature.
Mount slides with diamond mounting medium containing DAPI.
Visualize cells with the Leica TCS SP8 confocal microscopy station.
Digitize pictures with the Leica Application Suite X software.
Analyze two-dimensional images using ImageJ software.
Quantify white-light images using ImageJ software.
Evaluate microglia activation by immunofluorescence staining of desired markers.
Take 4 micrographs per well/condition using a fluorescence microscope.
